{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dance''' was a ritual that was sometimes performed during the [[Granee Noopa]]. It involved the event's two (or, more rarely, three) teams being pitted against each other in six rounds of combat. After the sixth round, a truce was called between the teams.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
